catalog.country_source: explicit OUT/EXIT code, unique flag, or repeated source country code; ambiguous/missing labels retained as unknown; not verified geolocation
catalog.country_partitioning: only when the full country exceeds the configuration byte budget
catalog.ordering: allowlist candidates, current success rate, median response time, jitter, upstream tie; countries by their best node
catalog.auto_selection: one best representative per country in country priority order, with shared-exit safeguards

quic_quality_gate: required except ordinary Vision intentionally blocks UDP/443

quality_checks.vantage: GitHub Actions runner; not a measurement from the client network
quality_checks.https: TLS-verified HEAD over TCP through the actual outbound
quality_checks.quic: TLS-verified HTTP/3 HEAD over SOCKS5 UDP ASSOCIATE; no TCP fallback; ordinary Vision is explicitly skipped, not counted as a successful QUIC test

ip_reputation.selection_priority: exclude listed addresses; retain unknown coverage; no reputation score ranking; allowlist evidence and current HTTPS quality order admitted nodes within countries, with upstream ties

dns_transport.route: reference routing; Yandex IP direct, Cloudflare IPs use the pool

subscription_policy.ad_blocking: reference win-spy/category-ads geosite rules; no filtering DNS provider
subscription_policy.vision_udp443: ordinary Vision intercepts UDP/443 as in the reference
reference_adaptations: own upstream connection credentials, endpoints and transport paths
